transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I just don’t seem to care about things I used to enjoy. Dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game night… they all feel like chores now, and I keep putting them off. It’s not like me, and I guess I’m worried about it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It started after the robbery at that festival job. So… about two years and three months ago now.
Have you had periods where you felt extremely down or depressed since the robbery?
Yeah… not like I’m crying all day or anything, but most days there’s this low feeling under everything. It’s like a sour mix of fear and guilt, even when nothing bad is actually happening.
Do you still find any pleasure in the things you used to enjoy, even if it's just a little?
A little, maybe, but not like before. Mostly I barely care about those things now. Dance, hiking, cooking something new, game night… they just feel like chores I keep putting off.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or look forward to?

Not really. I mean, I try to tell myself I should go to dance or plan a hike or cook something new, but I just… don’t care the way I used to. Even game night feels like something I have to make myself do, not something I look forward to.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in almost all activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I think so. It’s like the things that used to make me feel like myself—dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, even game night—I barely care about them now. They just sit there like chores I keep putting off.
How long have you been feeling this low, sour mix of fear and guilt most days?
Since the robbery at that festival job. So… about two years and three months now, most days.
Are there any activities that give you pleasure?

Not really. I mean, those things used to give me pleasure—dance class, hiking, cooking something new, game night—but now I barely care. They feel more like chores I keep avoiding than things I actually enjoy.
Do you feel like you've lost the ability to experience pleasure in things that normally would bring you joy?

Yeah… I think I have. I barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself—dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, even game night. They’re just kind of sitting there now, like chores I keep putting off.
How long have you been feeling this low, sour mix of emotions most days without any significant improvement?
It’s been since that robbery at the festival job… so about two years and three months. It hasn’t really lifted for any real stretch since then.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight since you started feeling this way?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed my weight changing in any big way.
Have you had periods of feeling normal or even happy since the robbery?
Not really in a lasting way. I might have a normal moment here and there, but most days there’s still this low, sour feeling under everything… fear and guilt, even when nothing bad is happening.
Have you had any periods lasting at least two months where you didn't feel this low, sour mix of emotions?
No, I don’t think there’s been a stretch that long. Most days that same low, sour feeling is still there—fear and guilt kind of underneath everything, even when nothing is actually happening.
Have you had any periods where you felt a return of interest in the activities you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I used to like things like dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game night… but now they just feel like chores I keep putting off. I barely care about them anymore, and that’s actually part of why I came in.
Have you felt this way for most of the past two years since the robbery?
Yes. It’s been most of the time since the robbery at that festival job… that was about two years and three months ago now.
Have your feelings of not caring about things and this low, sour mix of emotions been present for most of the day, most days?
Yes. Most days, for most of the day, it’s there in the background—this sour, low feeling with fear and guilt mixed in, even when nothing bad is actually happening.
Has this feeling of not caring about or enjoying things you used to like been going on for at least two years straight?

Yes. It’s been going on that long. I came in because I barely care about the things that used to feel like me—dance class, hiking, cooking, even game night. They just sit there now, like chores I keep putting off.
Have you had any time since the robbery where you felt significantly better for a while before feeling low again?

Not really. Since the robbery at that festival job—about two years and three months ago—it’s pretty much just been going on. I don’t remember a stretch where I felt really better and then slipped back down.
Has this low feeling you've described persisted without any significant improvement for the entire two years and three months since the robbery?
Yes. It’s been pretty steady since the robbery at that festival job, about two years and three months ago. I can’t really point to a time where it lifted in a significant way.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since the robbery?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a big change in my weight, at least not enough that it stood out to me.
